This Hanoi hotel offers proximity to natural sights like the freshwater West Lake (7 km) and Song Hong Flower Garden (3.6 km). The famous Hoa Lo Prison is about a 10-minute drive from the hotel. 528 Thuy Khue bus stop is also a short way from the accommodation.
